name: Paper 3 - Regime A - HDPE/Gd2O3 phi=0.189 (63.4 wt%)
description: Regime-A (effective-medium) benchmark: HDPE/Gd2O3 at volume fraction phi=0.189. Gives 63.42 wt% Gd2O3 / 36.58 wt% HDPE at rho_eff=2.107 g/cm3 (linear mixture rule: rho_f=7.07, rho_m=0.95). Gd K-edge at 50.239 keV falls just above the 50 keV grid point — providing uniquely tight K-edge resolution within the energy grid. Gadolinium is a strong thermal neutron absorber, making this material relevant for mixed-field shielding applications.
